I have been farming cabbage for 5 years here in Quzhou. My family has 50 mu of good flat land, and we do three seasons of cabbage — spring, summer, and autumn. I learned this system from my uncle and the seed dealer in town. I plant hybrid seeds, the same kind my neighbors use, mostly Zhonggan 56. A bag of hybrid seed costs more than traditional seed, but the seedlings grow strong and the heads are uniform, which matters when the vegetable broker comes to buy.

For fertilizer, I do what I did last year because it worked. I put down 50 kg of compound fertilizer per mu as a base — the bag says 15-15-15, so that gives some nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium all at once. Then I topdress twice during the growing season with another 100 kg per mu of high-nitrogen compound, something like 22-9-9 that the dealer recommends for leafy vegetables. That is about 30 kg of nitrogen, 15 kg of phosphorus, and 15 kg of potassium per mu in total. I know it is not cheap — every jin of fertilizer is real money — but cabbage is a heavy feeder and a bad harvest is a disaster. I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than risk small heads. I have a well for irrigation, so I water when the soil starts to look dry. Spring cabbage needs about 5 irrigations because the weather jumps around. Summer cabbage needs 6 times because July and August are scorching. Autumn cabbage usually only needs 4 times since the rain helps and the weather cools down.

For pests, I spray about 5 or 6 times each season. The cabbage worm is my main enemy, and in wet summers downy mildew shows up too. I hire a worker with a motorized sprayer because 50 mu is too much to do by hand. For tillage, I hire the rotary tiller from the village — it is 50 yuan per mu and saves time. I do not deep-plough because cabbage roots are shallow and rotary tillage is fast. I hire 10 to 15 people from the village for transplanting and harvest because with only me, my wife, and my parents, we cannot handle 50 mu alone.

I expect my spring cabbage to yield about 6,500 kg per mu, summer around 5,500 kg per mu because the heat hurts the heads, and autumn cabbage about 8,000 kg per mu when the weather is good. I sell almost everything to the broker who drives to the village.
